cohort: 200 females aged 20-45 years who underwent IPAA before the age of 20
finding: This study found that 73% of women who desired children after undergoing pediatric IPAA became pregnant, and 88% of those had a successful delivery.
mod_finding: 26/58 mothers had a vaginal delivery, while 27/58 had planned and 9/58 had unplanned cesarean sections.
